# Step 1: Review and serve your order

## Why review?

Copilot can propose a change, but a human must decide whether it matches the request. A green check is evidence, not a substitute for reading the change.

This is one five-minute exercise. Read, inspect, check, approve, and serve are activities within this step, not separate lessons. Take your time: hints and retries never reduce your score.

## Read your order

If you see Choose your order, explicitly create a new rehearsal with a chosen drink and unused run ID, or resume an existing rehearsal using its original ID. Keep that ID for recovery. Opening setup alone does not create or reset an exercise.

Choose Start rehearsal order. Read the assigned drink's name, price, serving style, artwork identifier, description, and one-drink scope in the order card and rehearsal issue.

Rehearsal uses a simulated issue, pull request, and check result, not real Copilot-authored work. Everything stays in this canvas; no GitHub writes or event submissions occur.

## Inspect the proposal

Open summary to read the proposal. Open changes to compare every added field with your order and confirm that existing items and their ordering are unchanged. Open checks to inspect the validation result. Use those three controls in that order.

A checked-off section only means you opened it. Read the actual diff and check result before deciding. Ask for a hint whenever helpful; no screenshots or external navigation are needed for rehearsal.

## Check the order

Enter the price, serving style, and change scope you found in the diff, then choose Check order details. Use your assigned order, not memorized answers from another drink.

If an answer does not match, follow the feedback back to Changes, compare again, and retry. If the proposal itself is wrong, do not approve it; ask booth staff for help.

## Approve, then serve

Choose Approve rehearsal change only when the proposal matches the order. Approval records your review decision; it is not a merge and does not yet put the drink on the menu.

Choose Apply rehearsal menu to serve the simulated drink. Serving saves the menu before preparing your local result. Live mode, when available, instead requires authentic native PR views inside the Copilot App and a separately authorized, verified merge. Canvas clicks cannot certify live review.

## Read your result

After serving succeeds, read your generated handle, 1,000-point score, and local rank in this canvas. Equal scores share rank. Rehearsal has no live leaderboard, issue update, or production QR code.

Inspect, check, approve: you compared the proposed change with the order before making a human review decision. This completes the only learner step; there is no next lesson to unlock.

## Resume or retry

Use Refresh progress to read saved state. If the menu was served but the result is delayed, choose Retry result. Reopening the same run resumes it; it does not reset your progress or generate a new result.

Staff handle connection problems and assign a fresh run for the next attendee. You never need a terminal, GitHub.com, or an external editor.
